title: ValidatorDescriptor
description: A single backend/UI validator applied to an entity property or form field.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: always set `type`. Use `required` for mandatory input, `minLength`/`maxLength`/`stringLength` for strings, `min`/`max`/`range` for numbers and comparable values, `pattern` or `regularExpression` for regex, and `email`, `phone`, `url`, or `creditCard` for common formats. Use lower-case validator names for new JSON. Add `message` only when a custom localized/user-facing message is needed.

type.description: Validator type. Prefer lower-case values in descriptor JSON; PascalCase aliases are accepted for compatibility.

message.description: Optional custom error message shown when validation fails. Omit to use the default localized message.

length.description: Length value for minLength or maxLength validators. Example: { "type": "maxLength", "length": 128 }.

value.description: Generic numeric value alias for single-value validators such as min/minimum, max/maximum, minLength/maxLength, and stringLength maximumLength.

minimum.description: Minimum value for min/minimum or range validators.

maximum.description: Maximum value for max/maximum or range validators.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern for pattern/regularExpression validators. Store the regex pattern string only; do not include leading/trailing slashes.

allowEmptyStrings.description: Whether required validation should allow empty strings. Usually false for user-entered text.
